name: vane-1-rc2
purpose: First full Vane 1 run: Granite R2 97m on the round-9/10 data (61,847 pairs after the consistency filter, 32x the pilot). Learns whether this much data moves Granite on v1 dev, where 1,875 pairs (rc1) did not. A release candidate only if it beats plain Granite on v1 dev; no publication and no default change without the human.

data.pairs: training/data/vane1/pairs-mined-all.jsonl = cat pairs-mined-b1.jsonl pairs-mined-b2.jsonl pairs-mined-b3.jsonl (82,807 rows; passage ids disjoint across batches). Checksums: training/manifests/vane1-data-b3.json (b1 and b2 also in vane1-data-b1/b2.json)
data.batches: b1: 6,743 real public passages (EU/DE/SE/US); b2: 2,000 and b3: 600 synthetic documents (corpus-v2); queries pairs-v2; filter_pairs.py, check_overlap.py (0 rows sharing text with nai-bench left), negatives mined with this base model (mine_negatives.py, margin 0.95)
data.rule: public domain, CC0, CC-BY, EU reuse texts and teacher-generated text only; no CC-BY-SA; nothing from nai-bench; no Claude output

command: docker compose -f training/docker/compose.rocm.yaml run --rm trainer sh -c 'mkdir -p training/runs/vane1-rc2 && timeout 3h python3 training/embed/train.py --pairs training/data/vane1/pairs-mined-all.jsonl --output-dir training/runs/vane1-rc2 --base-model ibm-granite/granite-embedding-97m-multilingual-r2 --release vane-1-rc2 --epochs 1 --batch-size 64 --learning-rate 2e-5 --max-seq-length 256 --file-negatives --hard-negatives 1 --max-positive-rank 49 --eval-steps 100 --seed 13 > training/runs/vane1-rc2/train.log 2>&1'
limits: unattended, capped at 3 hours (timeout 3h), log in training/runs/vane1-rc2/train.log
evaluation: evals/embeddings/dense_eval.py on the v1 dev split only (never test): rc2 vs plain granite97 and rc1, embedding-only and hybrid via RRF with nAI's BM25 order; per category, language and cross-language
